title: Charlie Barnet's band and meeting Red Norvo
summary: In Barnet's band he meets Red and Mildred Bailey; Red plays piano and writes Dance of the Octopus.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Why don't we go back to Charlie Barnet.
That was important because that's where I met Red and Mildred, (phonetic spelling). Red was always running away from Mildred; I guess it had a tendency to be sparkling, that marriage.
Red took to playing piano in Barnet's band.
What kind of a piano player was he?
He's good. Not forceful, but he played piano like he played (inaudible). He was a writer too, by the way. He wrote some pieces that were excellent, "Dance of the Octopus".
And he did the transcription of "In A Mist".
He did the charts for those, for "Dance of the Octopus"; he did the scoring for that, with the bass clarinet?
I think he did. He wrote the piece "Octopus".
And I think that he probably did that too. He confesses to not having enough patience to do it.
